speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Bastion Praetor core neutralized. The high fortress battlements are cleared. Flak artillery arrays across the stratospheric summit have gone completely silent.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: That was their supreme guardian? Heavy armor, but its servos couldn't take my kinetic hammer. Now look at those blast doors... thick enough to withstand orbital bombardment.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: Look at the atmospheric sensors. Barometric pressure is plummeting, but the temperature is surging. The entire summit is wrapped in a localized void hurricane.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: It is not weather. The Void Commander is siphoning raw energy from the upper atmosphere straight into the Throne Room. My bulwark shields are picking up intense electromagnetic distortion.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: The dissonance... it's deafening now. An overwhelming psychic frequency echoing from behind those doors. He knows we broke through his army, and he is waiting.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: I've sliced into the gate relays. The Praetor's biometric master key was the only lock left. Disengaging hydraulic security bolts... three... two... one.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Warning: Blast doors unsealing. Sensor telemetry beyond this threshold confirms the Void Commander's throne chamber. Extreme lethal power readings detected.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: Twelve sectors. We fought from the flooded ruins of Old Tokyo, through the underground bio-labs, up the Spire hull, and across these clouds. This is the end of the line.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: We set out to free this city, and we finish it together. Axiom Force, draw steel. Behind these doors is Judgment Day!
